purpose: Governing specification and interface contract for next genuine adaptive remeshing cycle (C4 -> C5) under Method C.

sharp_slit.topology: Zero-width sharp seam with coincident duplicate node pairs along flanks (x in [0.0, 0.04] mm)

ligament.topology: Continuous solid ligament with shared single nodes (x in [0.040606, 0.1] mm)

companion_continuum_error_indicator.formulation: Zienkiewicz-Zhu Superconvergent Patch Recovery (SPR) of Cauchy stresses
companion_continuum_error_indicator.marking_strategy: Threshold marking with eta_e >= 0.15 for refinement-candidate elements
companion_continuum_error_indicator.trajectory_notes: Autonomous error-driven marking; no geometric crack path is assumed or prescribed

historical_mesh_denominator.note: Package 114 companion run was conducted on the initial 4,422-element mesh prior to Turn 322 refinement-only reconciliation.

active_mesh_reconciliation.note: When mapped to the active 7,056-element C4 mesh, the 284 marked elements represent 4.025% of the total domain population, concentrating exclusively within the crack tip process corridor.

mesh_adaptation_governance.coarsening_factor_rule: coarseningFactor = NOT_ALLOWED (pre-refined corridor elements must never be coarsened)
mesh_adaptation_governance.transition_smoothing: Gradual element sizing grading <= 1.5 across adjacent element layers

flank_isolation_rule.description: Cross-slit interpolation is strictly forbidden. Upper-flank target entities must only sample from upper-flank donor elements, and lower-flank target entities must only sample from lower-flank donor elements.

nodal_displacement_transfer.method: Bilinear quad shape function evaluation inside containing donor element
nodal_displacement_transfer.inverse_solver: Newton-Raphson inverse isoparametric solver to tolerance 1e-12
nodal_displacement_transfer.continuity_requirement: Strict C0 continuity across non-slit boundaries

nodal_phase_field_transfer.method: Bilinear quad shape function evaluation inside containing donor element
nodal_phase_field_transfer.irreversibility_requirement: d_target(x) >= d_source(x) - eps (zero crack healing, eps <= 1e-9)

gauss_point_history_transfer.method: Host-nearest Gauss point transfer with conservative lower bound

active_set_and_initialization_format.encoding: 7+8+3 format in Abaqus UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (total 18 SVARS per GP)
active_set_and_initialization_format.svars_history_slots: SVARS 9 to 12 hold historical H at 4 integration points
active_set_and_initialization_format.solution_cards: *INITIAL CONDITIONS, TYPE=SOLUTION cards specifying SVARS for each element
active_set_and_initialization_format.active_set_boundary_cards: *BOUNDARY, OP=NEW cards clamping fully damaged nodes (d >= 0.9999) to 1.0
